original_methods.original_catalog_algorithm: catalog_v104_typed with unchanged original_candidates and original.orders
original_methods.representation: exact frozen source / changed production file, no user-authored winning builder or AST operation injected

catalog_gate: Execute original source-pinned emitter and all original MSI policy orders without native candidates, archive IDs/features/sha. Source-bound catalog must be Git-committed before subsequent native candidate trials. If zero or incomplete -> UNKNOWN, no fallback retargeting.
selection: Original V9 schedule union of each of the 37 policies' first 8 candidate IDs; any unverified, missing, skipped, error or timeout makes affected profile UNKNOWN (never FAIL); use original Pareto chooser only after complete profiles. Unique noncold verified selection needed before future source unseals.
causal_requirement: No G2 on training-only success. Future O2 must be newly independent, source-distinct and within unchanged horizon; full cold negative, selected positive, program withdrawal, cold reverified restoration and matched ledger/agent comparisons separate gates.
negative_controls: Wrong frozen file SHA, changed constructor MSI pin, altered catalog hash, source/test mutation, missing required native assertion, unsupported source/import, arbitrary candidate path / leaked head production => UNKNOWN or fail closed.
